mechanism: Both drugs can increase serum potassium levels; rosuvastatin may elevate potassium through effects on renal function, while eplerenone is a potassium-sparing aldosterone antagonist, creating additive hyperkalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function periodically; use combination cautiously in patients with baseline renal impairment, diabetes, or those on ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
